data.cultural_impact: The name 'Ram' is a well-known one in Hindu mythology and signifies strength, sacrifice, and duty. It is associated with the legendary king and avatar of Lord Vishnu, 'Lord Rama.'
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name 'Ram' is a revered spiritual name associated with Lord Rama, an embodiment of divine love, wisdom, and strength. The name represents the ideal human being who embodies the virtues of dharma (duty), artha (material wealth), kama (desire), and moksha (liberation). It is believed that chanting the name 'Ram' can bring peace and blessings.

The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama' which means 'pleasing' or 'delight'. These warriors were part of the royal armies and were highly revered for their martial skills.

Another reference suggests that Ramsh was a title given to Hindu saints and spiritual leaders in ancient India. These individuals were revered for their deep spiritual knowledge and inner peace.
